translations.text: Jude, servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to you, the chosen, who have been sanctified by God the Father and kept by Jesus Christ:
May mercy be with you, and may peace and love be multiplied!
Beloved, I made every effort to write to you about our common salvation. I thought it necessary to write to you, and I urge you to strive for the faith that was given to the saints once for all.

For certain men have crept in, who were written down long ago for this judgment. They are ungodly men who turn the grace of our God into impurity and deny the only Master, God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
I want to remind you, though you know all this, that God once saved the people from the land of Egypt, but afterwards destroyed those who did not believe.
And the angels who did not keep their own dominion but abandoned their dwelling place, he has kept under darkness in everlasting bonds for the judgment of the great day.

Likewise Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, which committed fornication in the same way as these and went after strange flesh, are set before us as an example of eternal fire, having received their judgment.
In the same way these men also see visions: they defile the flesh, despise dominions, and blaspheme glories.
But when Michael the archangel was disputing with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, he did not dare to bring a judgment of blasphemy against him, but said: "May the Lord rebuke you."
But these men blaspheme whatever they do not know, and whatever they know by nature, like brute beasts, by that they are corrupted.
Woe to them! For they walk in the way of Cain, they have rushed into the error of Balaam for reward, and they have perished in the rebellion of Korah.

These are the defiled ones who feast together with you at your love feasts and shepherd themselves without fear. They are waterless clouds carried about by the wind, fruitless winter trees, twice dead, pulled up by the roots,
raging waves of the sea, which foam up their own shame like froth, wandering stars, for whom the eternal gloom of darkness has been reserved.
Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them and said: "Behold, the Lord has come with myriads of his saints
to execute judgment upon all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their deeds of ungodliness that they committed lawlessly, and of all the harsh words that ungodly sinners have spoken against him."
These are grumblers and fault-finders, who walk according to their own desires. Their mouth speaks arrogant things, and they show favoritism for the sake of gain.
But you, beloved, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For they told you that in the last times there would be scoffers who walk according to their own ungodly desires.
These are the ones who separate themselves. They are worldly-minded and do not have the Spirit.
But you, beloved, build yourselves up on your holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.
Keep yourselves in the love of God, and wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to life.
Have mercy on some who are wavering,
And some you should save with fear, and snatch them out as from fire. Hate even the garment defiled by the flesh.
Now to him who is able to keep you without sin and to set you blameless before his glory with joy,
to the only wise God, our Saviour, be glory and riches, strength and authority, before all ages, and now, and unto ages of ages. Amen.
